import hmac
import hashlib
import time

def validate_reset_token(stored_token, provided_token, expiry_timestamp, secret_key):
    if not stored_token or not provided_token:
        return False
    current_time = time.time()
    if current_time > expiry_timestamp:
        return False
    expected_signature = hmac.new(
        secret_key.encode(),
        stored_token.encode(),
        hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    provided_signature = hmac.new(
        secret_key.encode(),
        provided_token.encode(),
        hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, provided_signature):
        return False
    return True
fix_rationale: Added a check at the beginning to return False if either stored_token or provided_token is None or empty, preventing AttributeError and ensuring degenerate inputs are explicitly rejected.
